notes.title: Announcement Trailer and Demo Release!
notes.notes:
We are so proud to announce the demo of our new game: Cards and Towers!

[previewyoutube=D7tr6NWu0fM;full][/previewyoutube]

Cards and Towers is a unique blend of card games, tower defense and roguelikes. Craft your own unique deck, protect your base tower, slay hordes of enemies, and survive as long as possible. Are you ready?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44992252/ea3faf0e2030d161ea846d2453168606b07d3e7f.png

This demo is a sneak peak of Cards and Towers, to show you how gameplay works, main mechanic and art of our game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44992252/4758c940a3417fa911314553cde96f6a1c0c6939.png

Play the demo and add the game to your wishlist to support the development of the game!

Family Devs.
